### Android fixes: the update installs, swipe everywhere, notifications

**Updates install properly now.** Elbiko was declaring the wrong thing to Android and then distrusting the result: the app never asked for the install permission the system requires, and after handing the APK over it waited three seconds to see whether the installer had appeared — a guess that almost always failed, so every update was declared broken and dumped into the browser. Now the download runs, Android's installer opens, and you tap **Update**. No browser detour.

**Swipe across the whole app.** It used to stop at the calendar. Swiping now moves through every section in the same order as the navigation — Dashboard, Focus, Tasks, Habits, Journal, Calendar, Syllabus, Test analysis, Sound, Share, Career, Settings.

**Notifications panel fixed.** It was timing out while loading the bridge instead of talking to Android. That lookup is now immediate, so the panel reports the real permission state instead of "the notification service did not answer".

This is an **Android-only release**: same Windows build as 3.0.1, no new installer.
